org.title: Organization
org.subtitle: Departments and sections own documents and decide what laboratory data each user sees. Every change asks for a reason; one that is still in use is deactivated, never deleted.
org.impactWarning: {{subject}} is still in use: {{documents}} active document(s), {{members}} active member(s) and {{work}} open work item(s). Deactivating it does not delete or move any of them, and it can be activated again. It can never be deleted while it is referenced.
org.impactDepartmentError: Could not check what uses this department.
org.impactSectionError: Could not check what uses this section.
org.saveError: The change could not be saved.
org.nothingRefers: Nothing refers to it at the moment.
org.noSections: No sections registered under this department.
org.needsPermission: Editing who belongs to which department needs the Users.Manage permission.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: System operating settings. Changes need a reason; security settings also need your electronic signature.
settings.loadError: Could not load the settings. Reload the page to try again.
settings.updated: {{key}} updated. It applies without a restart.
settings.notChangedNote: Shown for information. Secrets are never stored or displayed.
settings.sourceAndHow: Source and how to change it
settings.emailListLimit: Up to {{max}} addresses; empty means nobody.
settings.emailListHelper: One address per line, or separated by commas.
settings.testAlertDescription: Sends a clearly labelled test message to the configured critical-alert recipients.
settings.signatureMeaning: I am changing the system setting {{key}} from {{oldValue}} to {{newValue}}. Reason: {{reason}}
settings.noHistory: No changes recorded. The value has never been changed here.

accessReview.title: Access Review
accessReview.subtitle: Periodic review of who holds which access. The report is fixed when generated; the reviewer records findings and signs it.
accessReview.loadError: Could not load the access reviews. Reload the page to try again.
accessReview.generated: Access review generated as a draft.
accessReview.noReviews: No access review has been generated yet.
accessReview.qaOnly: Access reviews are decided and signed by Quality Assurance.
accessReview.checksumBad: The stored report no longer matches its checksum. Do not rely on it.
accessReview.generateIntro: Takes a snapshot of every account, active or not. The snapshot cannot be changed afterwards.
accessReview.noteHelper: Describe the change; it is made in Users or Roles with its own reason and signature.
accessReview.signatureMeaning: I have reviewed this access review report and its findings and attest to the conclusion below.
